policy: V10 keeps FULL_ONLY revenue reversal v1 unchanged and adds a separate multi-period post-close refund/chargeback adjustment path. Historical PeriodClose objects remain immutable. Late adjustments require explicit PeriodClose ancestry, exact accounting allocation, external evidence and cumulative ceilings against the original recognized revenue/tax/refund-reserve components.

additions.authority_note: Provenance-only immutable ancestry proof linking an original PeriodClose through an ordered cycle-free PeriodClose chain to the opening close of a later target period. It grants no posting, recognition or execution authority.

Human/multisig post-close REFUND/CHARGEBACK allocation authorization. It binds original recognized revenue and closed-period evidence, a period-chain proof, exact customer refund/revenue/reserve/tax/fee components, target accounting policy and requirement registry. AI authority is NONE and posting remains a separate re-verifying action.
